item.title: And so it goes…
item.description: The conflict in Ukraine and the war on Iran is reshaping the global order. The West, led by the US, refuses to accept the reality of multipolarity. This is exactly what these conflicts are about – the reshuffling of the geopolitical chessboard. CrossTalking with Dmitry Babich and Aleksandar Pavic.

item.title: Tightening noose
item.description: Can Trump bomb Iran to the peace table? Can escalation force an end to the conflict? At this point, escalation is only a tactic, not a strategy. This is why the United States and Israel continue to lose this war of choice. CrossTalking with Sulaiman Ahmed, Ali Salehian, and Bushra Shaikh.

item.title: Taco, again
item.description: It would seem that Trump can’t make up his mind. Continue the war he and Israel started with Iran, or pursue renewed negotiations? The problem is the US military does not have the means to continue the conflict and Iran is unlikely to accept any proposal from Trump. Iran has all the cards. CrossTalking with Dimitri Lascaris and David Swanson.

item.title: Out of options
item.description: The longer the US-Israel war of aggression on Iran goes on, the fewer good option are available to end it. In fact, with every passing day the war widens horizontally. While the American administration continues to claim victory, it is being forcibly pushed out of the Middle East.

item.title: Absence of strategy
item.description: It’s deja-vu all over again. The MoU ending the Iran war is in tatters. At the NATO meeting in Ankara, peace with Russia was not on the agenda. Instead, the now familiar agreement-incapable approach has overwhelming sway. It is obvious that the West is unable to think strategically. Peter Lavelle interviews Alastair Crooke.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: Iran’s full Strait
item.description: Trump says talks will continue, but the ceasefire is over. How does that work? In so many words, the US is still demanding Iran’s surrender. Also, exactly what is Washington’s position on the Ukraine conflict and are we witnessing a long-range strike war of attrition? CrossTalking with George Szamuely and Mark Sleboda.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: Ground invasion?
item.description: How many times does Trump want to lose the war on Iran? We will find out if a ground invasion is ordered – and it seems likely. Also, we are told Ukraine is winning. Then what explains the deepening internal divisions consuming the Kiev regime? CrossTalking with Mark Sleboda and George Szamuely.
